dct_description_sm: Dataset of physical limnological observations from Quesnel Lake, British Columbia, Canada produced during research conducted into the impact of the 4 August 2014 Mount Polley mine tailings dam spill. Included are conductivity-temperature-depth (CTD) profiles from 2006-2017, and mooring timeseries from 2014-2017.
